# E19: Quantified GHG Reporting and Certification

**Display ID:** E19  
**Pillar:** Environmental Criteria  
**Points:** 1  
**Mandatory for Certification:** No  
**Category:** Emissions  
**Applicability:** Project, Designing Entity  
**Project types:** Print, Digital, Hybrid  
**Related SDGs:** SDG 6, SDG 7, SDG 11, SDG 12, SDG 13, SDG 14, SDG 15

## Summary
Displays a publicly-accessible report of emissions, materials use, and waste.

## Description
Project: The project has a publicly-accessible quantified report of GHG reductions and/or energy, material use and waste disposal.

Design Entity: The design entity has a publicly-accessible quantified report of GHG reductions and/or energy, material use and waste disposal.

## Why it matters
Publicly-accessible reporting of materials, waste and emissions.
